2011-2012

WHEREAS, THE CLERK FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, HAS PREPARED AND SUBMITTED TO THE GOVERNING AUTHORITY, A BUDGET PROPOSAL FOR THE FISCAL YEAR BEGINNING JULY 01, 2011 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2012; AND

WHEREAS, THE TOWN COUNCIL OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA HAS STUDIED AND REVISED THE PROPOSED BUDGET, AND DOES HEREBY CONSIDER IT TO BE IN THE BEST INTEREST OF THE TOWN OF CLERMONT TO APPROVE THE BUDGET AS PROPOSED.

NOW, THEREFORE, BE IT RESOLVED BY THE TOWN COUNCIL FOR THE TOWN OF CLERMONT, GEORGIA, DULY ASSEMBLED AND BY UNANIMOUS VOTE THEREOF, THAT THE BUDGET

ATTACHED HERETO AND MADE A PART HEREOF FOR THE YEAR BEGINNING JULY 01, 2011 AND ENDING JUNE 30, 2012, IS ADOPTED.
